name: AI Image to Video
tagline: Turn a still photo into a short AI video in the browser, with a daily free plan.
description: AI Image to Video is a browser tool for turning a still into a short clip. Upload a PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP image (up to 20 MB), add an optional prompt, or start from text or reference media. The official $0 plan includes 2 videos every day with watermarked outputs; you need an account to generate and save projects. Pay-as-you-go is a one-time credit purchase with credits that never expire. Paid features include no watermarks.
